facts.blocks: MaximumBlockCount returns eight for all three exact classes, independently of physical key count.
facts.secondary: HasApplication2 returns true. NeoPro GetBlockApplications applies each SecondApplicationBlocks bit to the ordered input-block collection. GetBlockGroup resolves Application2 for true, otherwise the block primary application.
facts.group_order: Core LoadGroups clears the manager, visits blocks by increasing index and appends each non-nil resolved group. Duplicate associations retain their positions.
facts.area: Input GetAreaIfAvailable resolves AreaGroupAddress in the primary application with creation enabled; the read-only profile requires existing Area255 instead. AsCSV retains two Area getter observations, even when the Area column is absent.
facts.report: The inherited Neo IsInteractionGroup admits zero-based indices through seven. Slots nine through sixteen are unavailable.
facts.unit_order: Existing selection policy sorts units by numeric address within each Network and retains Network document order for project export; this is not full original report-manager execution.
